title: Console session
description: Screenshot of a terminal session: commands typed by an admin and their output (PowerShell or bash look, chosen by variant).

host.description: Machine the session runs on (used in the bash prompt and title).

cwd.description: Working directory shown in the prompt.

prompt.description: Exact prompt text, overriding the one built from user/host/cwd.

commands.description: Commands in order with their output.

output.description: Output exactly as printed, newlines and column spacing kept.

error.description: Render the output as an error (red).

showCursor.description: End with an empty prompt and a cursor.
